outliers.description:
Today’s video is a full glute day at Realm Fitness with my girl Arabella (@fitxbella). We’ve been wanting to train together for a while and finally made it happen . Lots of laughs, lots of glute burn, and lots of growing = the perfect session.
For those who are new here: I turned pro last June after winning the overall bikini title at the Toronto Pro Qualifier, and I’m currently focused on improving for my pro debut in 2026. Arabella is one of the sweetest and hardest-working athletes in the CPA and is pushing toward becoming the next Alberta bikini pro.
If you love glute training or want new ideas for your next leg day, I hope this workout gives you some inspiration. Let me know if you want more videos like this and I’ll film more girls’ training days.
Thanks for watching 🤍

outliers.title: Shri Rajat Sharma revealed his secret of calmness #rajatsharma #indiatv
outliers.description:
What’s the secret behind Shri Rajat Sharma’s calm, composed, and unshakeable personality? 🧘‍♂️
In this exclusive short conversation, the legendary journalist and news anchor Shri Rajat Sharma reveals that Yoga and Meditation are his biggest sources of peace, balance, and clarity in life.

He shares how the teachings of Swami Ramdev inspired him to begin his yoga journey — and how that practice became the foundation of his focus, emotional stability, and success. 🌿

This powerful message is a reminder that Yoga isn’t just for health or flexibility — it’s a path to inner strength, emotional control, and professional excellence.

Even people at the peak of their careers rely on Yoga to stay grounded and calm amidst chaos.
Let this inspire you to start your own yoga journey today — and experience the transformation yourself. 🙏
